summary.prose: Building this story fixes the activity-mode (streaming) review path in the CLI provider in two halves. The Ollama half adds the same checkOllama preflight and withOllama per-child env that the bounded claude path already uses, passed through runInProcessGroup's existing opts.env, so an Ollama-targeted review child is bound to the right endpoint with vendor login stripped and a failed preflight spawns nothing. The Vibe half replaces the outright rejection with a vibe branch that starts a runtime-verified Vibe app-server session and feeds its frames into ReviewActivityStream kind 'vibe' under the same read-only tool policy, alongside a lockstep diagnostics type widening and an additive mistral-large-4 catalog entry. Nine ordered tasks cover the provider edit, the stream/diagnostics widening, the vibe branch, the catalog entry, diagnostic detail, and the unit/integration/live test suite.
